sources.title: Towards Understanding Distilled Reasoning Models: A Representational ...
sources.snippet: Abstract In this paper, we investigate how model distillation impacts the development of reasoning features in large language models (LLMs). To explore this, we train a crosscoder on Qwen-series models and their fine-tuned variants. Our results suggest that the crosscoder learns features corresponding to various types of reasoning, including self-reflection and computation verification ...

sources.title: Artificial intelligence, conceptions of distillation and the reframing ...
sources.snippet: Abstract This article, which takes a specific example in order to look at how concepts shape developments in AI models, claims that the deployment of the concept of distillation is facilitating a particular reframing of reasoning within artificial intelligence.
